title: Attacker can block refunds to the fulfiller's account
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description   The current `fulfillQuery` pays refund gas to the query source. If the refund fails, the entire flow will revert. This means malicious users can always reject the completion of queries:  ```solidity QueryLogic.sol::L243             if (refundAmount > 0) {                 // slither-disable-next-line low-level-calls                 (bool refundSuccess,) = payment.source.call{value: refundAmount}("");                 if (!refundSuccess) revert NativeRefundFailed();             } ```  Attacker can:  0.
